issues.desc: CHK-002 is framed as implementation/test work rather than a user-observable checklist outcome; fold it into verification for the finding workflow item or reframe it around the observable guarantee that DEV finding grouping remains available and regression-protected.

The story touches phase gate / phaseTools behavior, a high-risk workflow gate surface, but the checklist does not explicitly require negative verification that only finding_cluster is newly allowed in DEV while unrelated L2 or gated commands remain blocked; PLAN should record the minimal-whitelist decision and verification boundary.

CHK-002 is framed as regression coverage rather than a user-observable product result. Tie it explicitly to the observable outcome that a DEV reviewer workflow can cluster findings before dispatch without the user hitting the SimCell B-cacf gate failure again.
